description: Hospice finder + Hospice Care Index — Find Medicare hospices by city+state (also zip, name or ccn) ranked by the CMS Hospice Care Index (0-10) with ownership, certification date and flags. With ccn= (or a search matching one hospice) adds full detail: HIS quality measures (pain/dyspnea screening, treatment preferences, visits in last days of life), the 10 HCI indicators with national percentiles, average daily census, patient diagnosis mix and care settings. Optional: zip, name, ccn, limit (1-100). Source: CMS Provider Data Catalog (public domain). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: health_hospice
